districtFact: Federal Way Public Schools builds its family calendar around Friday releases that end 75 minutes early, two annual Scholar-Led Conference closures, Kindergarten Connection half days at the start of school, a two-hour late start after Winter Break, a separate seniors' last day, and conditional snow make-up dates. FWPS reports 121 languages spoken among district families and publishes translated school-year calendar PDFs.

about.title: About Federal Way Public Schools
about.content: Federal Way Public Schools serves Federal Way and portions of Des Moines, Auburn, Kent, and unincorporated King County. The district profile lists 37 schools across a 35-square-mile service area: 20 elementary schools, three K-8 schools, six middle schools, four high schools, and four specialized schools with alternate learning experiences.

about.title: A Friday-Based Early-Release Calendar
about.content: FWPS schedules most regular early releases on selected Fridays rather than using the Wednesday pattern common in nearby Puget Sound districts. For 2026-2027, the district says students leave 75 minutes early so staff can use the time for professional learning, collaboration, and student-data review. Separate early-dismissal dates before Thanksgiving and on the last day use different bell times, so families should not treat every shortened day as the same schedule.

about.title: Kindergarten Starts With Kindergarten Connection Conferences
about.content: The one-page calendars place the first kindergarten date at the opening of a multi-day Kindergarten Connection window. During that window, the calendar calls for conferences and half days for kindergarten. The live 2026-2027 district calendar further distinguishes the K-12 first day from the first regular full day for kindergarten and Bright Futures Kindergarten.

about.title: Calendar Access for a Multilingual Community
about.content: FWPS reports that 121 languages are spoken across its families. For 2026-2027 through 2028-2029, the district publishes the same school-year calendar in Dari, Korean, Pashto, Russian, Somali, Spanish, and Ukrainian as well as English. These are language-access copies of the district calendar, not alternate attendance schedules.

planningTips.title: Federal Way Public Schools Calendar Notes
content: Regular Friday early releases are 75 minutes earlier than normal, but they do not occur every Friday. Use the exact date list for the selected school year and confirm the school's release time.

Kindergarten Connection dates are conferences and half days for kindergarten. The first full kindergarten day can come after the K-12 opening date, so use the live district calendar and school message for the full-day transition.
Scholar-Led Conference dates are no-school days, not regular Friday early releases. FWPS directs families to ParentVUE for conference scheduling information.
The first school day after Winter Break is marked as a two-hour late start in each reviewed PDF. Transportation and bell times therefore differ from a regular return day.
The Wednesday before Thanksgiving is an early-dismissal day, while Thanksgiving Thursday and Friday are no-school days. These use different schedule labels and should remain separate in family plans.
Snow make-up dates remain no-school days unless FWPS activates them. Several are placed after the scheduled last day, so verify the June ending before finalizing travel or summer care.
Seniors have a separate last day before the districtwide last day. Graduation events and campus-specific senior deadlines should still be checked with the high school.
Use translated PDFs for household language access, but use the live FWPS calendar and school alerts for revisions, bell times, preschool dates, and emergency changes.

districtFaqs.q: What day does Federal Way Public Schools release early?
districtFaqs.a: FWPS schedules regular early releases on selected Fridays. For 2026-2027, students are released 75 minutes early, beginning September 18. The exact Friday list changes each year, and the pre-Thanksgiving and last-day early dismissals follow separate schedules.

districtFaqs.q: Does FWPS release early every Friday?
districtFaqs.a: No. Many Fridays are early-release days, but conference closures, professional-development days, holidays, breaks, and other calendar exceptions interrupt the pattern. Check the exact dates for the current school year rather than assuming every Friday is shortened.

districtFaqs.q: How does Kindergarten Connection affect the first week?
districtFaqs.a: FWPS marks a multi-day Kindergarten Connection window with conferences and half days for kindergarten. The live calendar may separately identify the first full day for kindergarten and Bright Futures Kindergarten, so families should confirm the transition schedule with their school.

districtFaqs.q: Are Scholar-Led Conference dates school days in Federal Way?
districtFaqs.a: No. The FWPS calendars label Scholar-Led Conference dates as no-school days. They are different from the district's regular Friday early releases, and students do not attend school on those dates.

districtFaqs.q: What happens on the first day after FWPS Winter Break?
districtFaqs.a: Each reviewed calendar marks the first school day after Winter Break as a two-hour late start. Check the school or district transportation information for the exact start and bus times.

districtFaqs.q: Are FWPS snow make-up days automatic school days?
districtFaqs.a: No. The PDFs label them as no-school days unless needed. FWPS may activate one after a closure, including dates near or after the scheduled last day, so families should verify the current district announcement before making plans.

districtFaqs.q: Does FWPS publish calendars in languages other than English?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. For 2026-2027 through 2028-2029, FWPS provides calendar PDFs in Dari, Korean, Pashto, Russian, Somali, Spanish, and Ukrainian in addition to English.

customSections.label: Language Access for FWPS Calendars
customSections.content: FWPS reports 121 languages spoken among district families. The district publishes translated calendar PDFs in Spanish, Dari, Ukrainian, Pashto, Russian, Somali, and Korean; each version contains the same districtwide dates as the English calendar.
